components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of 'MR', 'MRS', 'MS' or 'DR'.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned when present.
          type: string
          pattern: '^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$'
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Optional on input when the structured
            'addressLine1' (and optional 'addressLine2') fields are supplied instead; the flat form
            stays accepted for backward compatibility. On output this is always the composed,
            normalized address: the normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present, or the normalized flat address
            when only the flat form was supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address (street number and name). When supplied
            non-blank it takes precedence over the flat 'address' input. Stored and returned
            normalized (whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            An optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, level, etc.). Stored and
            returned normalized; appended to 'addressLine1' to form the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Submitted numbers may include spaces,
            dashes and brackets and may carry an explicit '+' country code; they are stored
            and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). A number without a
            '+' is assumed to be Australian ('+61'), dropping a single leading '0'.
          type: string
          minLength: 2
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]{2,20}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 3
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per the
            fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on creation it
            defaults to the server's current date. Formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when present.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time flag. A household is keyed on (lastName, postcode); a second owner in an
            existing household is normally rejected with 409 Conflict. When true, this flag bypasses
            that household duplicate block, so the owner is created as a declared household member
            (and is not flagged as a possible duplicate). It does not create the household link — the
            householdId is always derived from lastName and postcode. When false or omitted, a second
            owner in an existing household is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The major version of the owner representation. Version 2 groups the owner's
                identifiers under the nested 'identity' object and derives those identifiers with the
                version-2 identity algorithm. A fixed value of 2.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identifiers (memberId, householdId and identityKey), grouped
                together. All three are derived with the version-2 identity algorithm, which mixes a
                fixed 'V2' version tag into the region code used inside each identifier so that no
                value produced under version 1 is reproduced. These are identifiers only; the
                user-facing 'locality', 'timezone' and owner-segment region remain the plain region.
              readOnly: true
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path to this owner, formatted '/api/owners/' followed by the
                owner's id. Derived at read time.
              type: string
              example: /api/owners/1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived at read time as the honorific 'title' followed by a
                single space and the lastName (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the lastName when no title was
                supplied.
              type: string
              example: DR Franklin
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived
                at read time from the raw 'telephone', which stays in E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The financial year of the owner's business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named for the calendar year in
                which it ends, so a registration on or after 1 July falls in the next year's fiscal
                year (e.g. October 2026 -> FY27). Derived at read time.
              type: string
              example: FY27
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier shared by owners who belong to the same household (same
                last name and postcode). It is the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the
                normalized 'lastName|postcode', so owners with the same last name and postcode share
                it automatically. Owners with no postcode belong to no household and carry no value.
              type: string
              example: 3A7F9C2E1B4D
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                A derived descriptive key for the owner, formatted
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' where normalizedTelephone is the E.164
                telephone, email is the lower-cased email (empty when absent) and householdId is the
                owner's deterministic household id (empty when the owner has no postcode). Duplicate
                detection keys off the householdId: a second owner in an existing household is
                rejected with 409 Conflict unless the request opts in with 'sharesHousehold: true'.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|3A7F9C2E1B4D'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that already shared this owner's first and last name
                (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created. Assigned at
                creation and never changed afterwards.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's registration
                date at the moment this owner was created. Assigned at creation and never changed
                afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners (inclusive) at the
                moment this owner was created, approaching the hard per-city capacity limit of 50.
                Assigned at creation and never changed afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether, at creation, this owner shared an existing owner's last name and postcode
                while carrying a different telephone (a soft match that is not a hard identity
                duplicate). Such an owner is still created but flagged. Assigned at creation and
                never changed afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched at creation (same last name and
                postcode, different telephone). Present only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                A derived review signal, true when any of these hold and false otherwise: the owner
                is a possible duplicate ('possibleDuplicate'), the owner's email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (shares its registrable name with a known disposable provider —
                e.g. a subdomain of, or a sibling TLD of, a disposable domain — while not being an
                exactly blocked disposable domain, which is rejected at creation), or the owner's
                city is over its soft capacity ('capacityWarning'). Derived at read time from the
                stored flags and email, so it can never drift.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned at creation. Points start at 0 and gain 2
                when an email address is present, 1 when namesakeCount is 0, 2 for a household of 3
                or more members, and 3 when tenure exceeds 1 elapsed fiscal year. Tenure is counted
                in elapsed fiscal years from the registration date, so a newly created owner (zero
                tenure) never earns the tenure points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned at creation by mapping
                membershipPoints to a band: 0-1 points is level 1, 2-3 is level 2, 4-5 is level 3,
                and 6 or more is level 4.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, derived at read time as '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO'
                when the owner's locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: STANDARD_METRO
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region, read at read time from the REGION segment of the owner's
                memberId (the region-and-hash identity). REGION is derived from the postcode
                (preferring the postcode's region, falling back to the fixed city-to-region table:
                Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived at read time from the owner's locality/region via the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region has no mapping.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred contact channel derived at read time from the owner's details:
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived at read time from 'birthDate' measured against the
                owner's 'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false;
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the record. Owners
                flagged deleted are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity
                checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

lines: -                A deterministic identifier shared by owners who belong to the same household (same
-                last name and postcode). It is the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the
-                normalized 'lastName|postcode', so owners with the same last name and postcode share
-                it automatically. Owners with no postcode belong to no household and carry no value.
-                A derived descriptive key for the owner, formatted
-                telephone, email is the lower-cased email (empty when absent) and householdId is the
-                owner's deterministic household id (empty when the owner has no postcode). Duplicate
-                detection keys off the householdId: a second owner in an existing household is
-                rejected with 409 Conflict unless the request opts in with 'sharesHousehold: true'.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of 'MR', 'MRS', 'MS' or 'DR'.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned when present.
          type: string
          pattern: '^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$'
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Optional on input when the structured
            'addressLine1' (and optional 'addressLine2') fields are supplied instead; the flat form
            stays accepted for backward compatibility. On output this is always the composed,
            normalized address: the normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present, or the normalized flat address
            when only the flat form was supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address (street number and name). When supplied
            non-blank it takes precedence over the flat 'address' input. Stored and returned
            normalized (whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            An optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, level, etc.). Stored and
            returned normalized; appended to 'addressLine1' to form the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Submitted numbers may include spaces,
            dashes and brackets and may carry an explicit '+' country code; they are stored
            and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). A number without a
            '+' is assumed to be Australian ('+61'), dropping a single leading '0'.
          type: string
          minLength: 2
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]{2,20}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 3
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per the
            fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on creation it
            defaults to the server's current date. Formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when present.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time flag. A household is keyed on (lastName, postcode); a second owner in an
            existing household is normally rejected with 409 Conflict. When true, this flag bypasses
            that household duplicate block, so the owner is created as a declared household member
            (and is not flagged as a possible duplicate). It does not create the household link — the
            householdId is always derived from lastName and postcode. When false or omitted, a second
            owner in an existing household is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The major version of the owner representation. Version 2 groups the owner's
                identifiers under the nested 'identity' object and derives those identifiers with the
                version-2 identity algorithm. A fixed value of 2.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identifiers (memberId, householdId and identityKey), grouped
                together. All three are derived with the version-2 identity algorithm, which mixes a
                fixed 'V2' version tag into the region code used inside each identifier so that no
                value produced under version 1 is reproduced. These are identifiers only; the
                user-facing 'locality', 'timezone' and owner-segment region remain the plain region.
              readOnly: true
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path to this owner, formatted '/api/owners/' followed by the
                owner's id. Derived at read time.
              type: string
              example: /api/owners/1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived at read time as the honorific 'title' followed by a
                single space and the lastName (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the lastName when no title was
                supplied.
              type: string
              example: DR Franklin
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived
                at read time from the raw 'telephone', which stays in E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The financial year of the owner's business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named for the calendar year in
                which it ends, so a registration on or after 1 July falls in the next year's fiscal
                year (e.g. October 2026 -> FY27). Derived at read time.
              type: string
              example: FY27
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that already shared this owner's first and last name
                (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created. Assigned at
                creation and never changed afterwards.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's registration
                date at the moment this owner was created. Assigned at creation and never changed
                afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners (inclusive) at the
                moment this owner was created, approaching the hard per-city capacity limit of 50.
                Assigned at creation and never changed afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether, at creation, this owner shared an existing owner's last name and postcode
                while carrying a different telephone (a soft match that is not a hard identity
                duplicate). Such an owner is still created but flagged. Assigned at creation and
                never changed afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched at creation (same last name and
                postcode, different telephone). Present only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                A derived review signal, true when any of these hold and false otherwise: the owner
                is a possible duplicate ('possibleDuplicate'), the owner's email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (shares its registrable name with a known disposable provider —
                e.g. a subdomain of, or a sibling TLD of, a disposable domain — while not being an
                exactly blocked disposable domain, which is rejected at creation), or the owner's
                city is over its soft capacity ('capacityWarning'). Derived at read time from the
                stored flags and email, so it can never drift.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned at creation. Points start at 0 and gain 2
                when an email address is present, 1 when namesakeCount is 0, 2 for a household of 3
                or more members, and 3 when tenure exceeds 1 elapsed fiscal year. Tenure is counted
                in elapsed fiscal years from the registration date, so a newly created owner (zero
                tenure) never earns the tenure points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned at creation by mapping
                membershipPoints to a band: 0-1 points is level 1, 2-3 is level 2, 4-5 is level 3,
                and 6 or more is level 4.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, derived at read time as '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO'
                when the owner's locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: STANDARD_METRO
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region, read at read time from the REGION segment of the owner's
                memberId (the region-and-hash identity). REGION is derived from the postcode
                (preferring the postcode's region, falling back to the fixed city-to-region table:
                Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived at read time from the owner's locality/region via the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region has no mapping.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred contact channel derived at read time from the owner's details:
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived at read time from 'birthDate' measured against the
                owner's 'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false;
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the record. Owners
                flagged deleted are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity
                checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:

        totalElements:

input.old_string:
required:

input.new_string:
required:
            - pets
    OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's derived identifiers, grouped together on the owner response. Every identifier is
        derived with the version-2 identity algorithm: a fixed 'V2' version tag is mixed into the
        region code used inside each identifier, so every value differs from the one version 1 would
        have produced. The region code mixed in here is internal to the identifiers and is never the
        user-facing 'locality'.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The owner's single unified member identifier, whose segments run together with no
            separators, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': REGION is the version-2 region code (the
            plain region with the fixed 'V2' tag mixed in), FY is the two-digit fiscal year (the
            financial year of the registrationDate, named by its ending calendar year), HASH8 is the
            first eight upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized (E.164) telephone
            concatenated with lastName, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits
            of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Assigned at creation; it carries no sequence number. Should two
            owners produce the same id, a '-<n>' suffix is appended to keep them unique.
          type: string
          example: V2NSW271A2B3C4D5
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            A deterministic identifier shared by owners who belong to the same household (same last
            name and postcode). It is the first 12 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the
            normalized 'region|lastName|postcode', where region is the version-2 region code, so
            owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically. Owners with no
            postcode belong to no household and carry no value.
          type: string
          example: 3A7F9C2E1B4D
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            A derived key for the owner, the lower-case hex SHA-256 of
            'region|normalizedTelephone|email|soundex(lastName)', where region is the version-2 region
            code, normalizedTelephone is the E.164 telephone (empty when absent), email is the
            lower-cased email (empty when absent) and soundex(lastName) is the phonetic code of the
            last name. Hard-duplicate detection rejects a second owner with the same identity key with
            409 Conflict.
          type: string
          example: 9f2c1b4d7e8a3f5c2b1d0e9f8a7b6c5d4e3f2a1b0c9d8e7f6a5b4c3d2e1f0a9b
          readOnly: true
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of 'MR', 'MRS', 'MS' or 'DR'.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned when present.
          type: string
          pattern: '^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$'
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Optional on input when the structured
            'addressLine1' (and optional 'addressLine2') fields are supplied instead; the flat form
            stays accepted for backward compatibility. On output this is always the composed,
            normalized address: the normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present, or the normalized flat address
            when only the flat form was supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address (street number and name). When supplied
            non-blank it takes precedence over the flat 'address' input. Stored and returned
            normalized (whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            An optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, level, etc.). Stored and
            returned normalized; appended to 'addressLine1' to form the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Submitted numbers may include spaces,
            dashes and brackets and may carry an explicit '+' country code; they are stored
            and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). A number without a
            '+' is assumed to be Australian ('+61'), dropping a single leading '0'.
          type: string
          minLength: 2
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]{2,20}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 3
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per the
            fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on creation it
            defaults to the server's current date. Formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when present.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time flag. A household is keyed on (lastName, postcode); a second owner in an
            existing household is normally rejected with 409 Conflict. When true, this flag bypasses
            that household duplicate block, so the owner is created as a declared household member
            (and is not flagged as a possible duplicate). It does not create the household link — the
            householdId is always derived from lastName and postcode. When false or omitted, a second
            owner in an existing household is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The major version of the owner representation. Version 2 groups the owner's
                identifiers under the nested 'identity' object and derives those identifiers with the
                version-2 identity algorithm. A fixed value of 2.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identifiers (memberId, householdId and identityKey), grouped
                together. All three are derived with the version-2 identity algorithm, which mixes a
                fixed 'V2' version tag into the region code used inside each identifier so that no
                value produced under version 1 is reproduced. These are identifiers only; the
                user-facing 'locality', 'timezone' and owner-segment region remain the plain region.
              readOnly: true
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path to this owner, formatted '/api/owners/' followed by the
                owner's id. Derived at read time.
              type: string
              example: /api/owners/1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived at read time as the honorific 'title' followed by a
                single space and the lastName (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the lastName when no title was
                supplied.
              type: string
              example: DR Franklin
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived
                at read time from the raw 'telephone', which stays in E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The financial year of the owner's business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named for the calendar year in
                which it ends, so a registration on or after 1 July falls in the next year's fiscal
                year (e.g. October 2026 -> FY27). Derived at read time.
              type: string
              example: FY27
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that already shared this owner's first and last name
                (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created. Assigned at
                creation and never changed afterwards.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's registration
                date at the moment this owner was created. Assigned at creation and never changed
                afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners (inclusive) at the
                moment this owner was created, approaching the hard per-city capacity limit of 50.
                Assigned at creation and never changed afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether, at creation, this owner shared an existing owner's last name and postcode
                while carrying a different telephone (a soft match that is not a hard identity
                duplicate). Such an owner is still created but flagged. Assigned at creation and
                never changed afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched at creation (same last name and
                postcode, different telephone). Present only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                A derived review signal, true when any of these hold and false otherwise: the owner
                is a possible duplicate ('possibleDuplicate'), the owner's email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (shares its registrable name with a known disposable provider —
                e.g. a subdomain of, or a sibling TLD of, a disposable domain — while not being an
                exactly blocked disposable domain, which is rejected at creation), or the owner's
                city is over its soft capacity ('capacityWarning'). Derived at read time from the
                stored flags and email, so it can never drift.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned at creation. Points start at 0 and gain 2
                when an email address is present, 1 when namesakeCount is 0, 2 for a household of 3
                or more members, and 3 when tenure exceeds 1 elapsed fiscal year. Tenure is counted
                in elapsed fiscal years from the registration date, so a newly created owner (zero
                tenure) never earns the tenure points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned at creation by mapping
                membershipPoints to a band: 0-1 points is level 1, 2-3 is level 2, 4-5 is level 3,
                and 6 or more is level 4.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, derived at read time as '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO'
                when the owner's locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: STANDARD_METRO
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region for the owner, derived at read time from the postcode (preferring
                the postcode's region, falling back to the fixed city-to-region table: Sydney -> NSW,
                Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves. This is the
                plain region code (e.g. 'NSW'); it is not an identifier and never carries the 'V2'
                version tag that the identity algorithm mixes into the identifiers.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived at read time from the owner's locality/region via the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region has no mapping.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred contact channel derived at read time from the owner's details:
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived at read time from 'birthDate' measured against the
                owner's 'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false;
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the record. Owners
                flagged deleted are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity
                checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:

        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
